arxiv-1507-03680.title: Transitioning to Proof
arxiv-1507-03680.creator: Diane Resek, Dan Fendel
arxiv-1507-03680.description: Abstract This paper describes some strategies used in a ‘transition’ course. Such courses help undergraduate mathematics majors move from learning procedures to learning to function as critical mathematicians in order to understand and work with abstract concepts. One of the co-authors of this paper was a student of Leon Henkin.

arxiv-1907-12848.title: Don’t go chasing artificial waterfalls: Simulating cascading failures in the power grid and the impact of artificial line-limit methods on results
arxiv-1907-12848.creator: J. Bourne, A. O’Sullivan, E. Arcaute
arxiv-1907-12848.description: Abstract Research into cascading failures in power-transmission networks requires detailed data on the capacity of individual transmission lines. However, these data are often unavailable to researchers. As a result, line limits are often modelled by assuming they are proportional to some average load. Little research exists, however, to support this assumption as being realistic.

arxiv-2201-08115.title: Priors, Hierarchy, and Information Asymmetry for Skill Transfer in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2201-08115.creator: Sasha Salter, Kristian Hartikainen, Walter Goodwin, Ingmar Posner
arxiv-2201-08115.description: Abstract The ability to discover behaviours from past experience and transfer them to new tasks is a hallmark of intelligent agents acting sample-efficiently in the real world. Equipping embodied reinforcement learners with the same ability may be crucial for their successful deployment in robotics.

arxiv-2303-14562.title: Resolution Complete In-Place Object Retrieval given Known Object Models
arxiv-2303-14562.creator: Daniel Nakhimovich, Yinglong Miao, Kostas E. Bekris
arxiv-2303-14562.description: Abstract This work proposes a robot task planning framework for retrieving a target object in a confined workspace among multiple stacked objects that obstruct the target. The robot can use prehensile picking and in-workspace placing actions. The method assumes access to 3D models for the visible objects in the scene. arxiv-2402-09409.title: Season’s Greetings by AD
arxiv-2402-09409.creator: Uwe Naumann
arxiv-2402-09409.description: Abstract We use Algorithmic Differentiation (AD) [ 1 ] to implement type-generic tangent and adjoint versions of y = ∑ i = 0 n − 1 x 2 ​ i ⋅ x 2 ​ i + 1 y=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}x_{2i}\cdot x_{2i+1} in C++.

arxiv-2405-06506.title: Scattering of dark pions in Sp(4) gauge theory
arxiv-2405-06506.creator: Yannick Dengler, Axel Maas, Fabian Zierler
arxiv-2405-06506.description: Abstract Analyses of astrophysical data provide first hints on the self-interactions of dark matter at low energies. Lattice calculations of dark matter theories can be used to investigate them, especially in the case of strongly-interacting dark matter. We consider Sp(4) gauge theory with two fundamental fermions as a candidate theory.

arxiv-2405-13144.title: LLMs for Mathematical Modeling: Towards Bridging the Gap between Natural and Mathematical Languages
arxiv-2405-13144.creator: Xuhan Huang, Qingning Shen, Yan Hu, Anningzhe Gao, Benyou Wang1 The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen2 Shenzhen Research Institute of Big Data xuhanhuang,qingningshen@link.cuhk.edu.cn, huyan@cuhk.edu.cn
arxiv-2405-13144.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across various natural language processing tasks, yet their proficiency in mathematical reasoning remains a key challenge. Addressing the gap between natural and mathematical language requires advanced reasoning capabilities, approaching those of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).

arxiv-2412-04113.title: Sharp-Interface Limit of the Cahn-Hilliard-Biot Equations
arxiv-2412-04113.creator: Erlend Storvik, Carina Bringedal
arxiv-2412-04113.description: Abstract Abstract In this letter, we derive the sharp-interface limit of the Cahn-Hilliard-Biot equations using formal matched asymptotic expansions. We find that in each sub-domain, the quasi-static Biot equations are obtained with domain-specific material parameters. Moreover, across the interface, material displacement and pore pressure are continuous, while volumetric fluid content and normal stress are balanced.

arxiv-2502-08793.title: Designing Flat Bands, Localized and Itinerant States in TaS 2 Trilayer Heterostructures
arxiv-2502-08793.creator: Hyeonhu Bae, Roser Valentí, Igor I. Mazin, Binghai Yan
arxiv-2502-08793.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hyeonhu Bae, Roser Valentí, Igor I. Mazin, Binghai Yan. Stacking and twisting van der Waals materials provide a powerful tool to design quantum matter and engineer electron correlation. For instance, monolayers of 1T- and 1H-TaS 2 are Mott insulating and metallic (also superconducting), respectively, and thus, the T/H bilayer systems have been extensively investigated in the context of heavy fermions and unconventional superconductivity, which are expected phases from localized spins (1T) coexisting with itinerant electrons (1H).

arxiv-2510-27302.title: High-Precision Newton-Kantorovich Method for Nonlinear Integral Equations
arxiv-2510-27302.creator: Kirill A. Chertoganov, Valery I. Shipalov
arxiv-2510-27302.description: Abstract The paper considers the numerical solution of nonlinear integral equations using the Newton–Kantorovich method with the mpmath library. High-precision quadrature of the kernel K ⁡ ( t , s , u ) K(t,s,u) with respect to the variable s s for fixed t t increases stability and accuracy in problems sensitive to rounding and dispersion.

arxiv-2601-12075.title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Copying Is Easier to Induce Than Recall
arxiv-2601-12075.creator: Mehrdad Farahani Franziska Penzkofer Richard Johansson
arxiv-2601-12075.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mehrdad Farahani Franziska Penzkofer Richard Johansson. Language models used in retrieval-augmented settings must arbitrate between parametric knowledge stored in their weights and contextual information in the prompt. This work presents a mechanistic study of that choice by extracting an arbitration vector from model activations on a curated dataset designed to disentangle (i) irrelevant contexts that elicit parametric recall and (ii) relevant but false contexts that elicit copying.

pmc-11386954.title: Mechanical force of uterine occupation enables large vesicle extrusion from proteostressed maternal neurons
pmc-11386954.creator: Guoqiang Wang, Ryan J Guasp, Sangeena Salam, Edward Chuang, Andrés Morera, Anna J Smart, David Jimenez, Sahana Shekhar, Emily Friedman, Ilija Melentijevic, Ken C Nguyen, David H Hall, Barth D Grant, Monica Driscoll, Patrick J Hu, Guoqiang Wang, Ryan J Guasp, Sangeena Salam, Edward Chuang, Andres Mor
pmc-11386954.description: Large vesicle extrusion from neurons may contribute to spreading pathogenic protein aggregates and promoting inflammatory responses, two mechanisms leading to neurodegenerative disease. Factors that regulate the extrusion of large vesicles, such as exophers produced by proteostressed C. elegans touch neurons, are poorly understood. Here, we document that mechanical force can significantly potentiate exopher extrusion from proteostressed neurons.

pmc-11478169.title: Cu-Al-Ni Nanocrystalline Compacts Obtained by Spark Plasma Sintering of Mechanically Alloyed Powders
pmc-11478169.creator: Calin-Virgiliu Prica, Traian Florin Marinca, Florin Popa, Argentina Niculina Sechel, Bogdan Viorel Neamțu, Horea Florin Chicinaș, Ionel Chicinaș, Wenming Jiang
pmc-11478169.description: The aim of this work is to obtain Cu-13.5Al-4Ni alloy for use as shape memory alloy by Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS) of mechanically alloyed powder. The study investigates the structural and microstructural changes in terms of crystal parameters, crystallite sizes, and phases evolution during mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering of Cu-13.5Al-4Ni powders.

pmc-11524523.creator: Shuang Lin, Shengda Zhang, Chaofeng Wang, Fan He, Zhizhen Xu, Yuchen Zhang
pmc-11524523.description: Jet fuel plays a crucial role as an essential energy source in aerospace and aviation operations. The recent increase in fuel prices has presented airlines with the new challenge of managing jet fuel costs to ensure consistent cash flow and minimize operational uncertainties.

pmc-11660993.description: Background/PurposeWe evaluated the minimally invasive surgery for congenital biliary dilatation (CBD) in adults and children and analyzed the surgical outcomes, especially in children aged <6 years.MethodsCharacteristics and surgical outcomes of patients with CBD who underwent minimally invasive surgery at our hospital between 2013 and 2023 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-11677618.title: Comprehensive Blood Metabolome and Exposome Analysis, Annotation, and Interpretation in E-Waste Workers
pmc-11677618.creator: Zhiqiang Pang, Charles Viau, Julius N. Fobil, Niladri Basu, Jianguo Xia
pmc-11677618.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Electronic and electrical waste (e-waste) production has emerged to be of global environmental public health concern. E-waste workers, who are frequently exposed to hazardous chemicals through occupational activities, face considerable health risks. Methods: To investigate the metabolic and exposomic changes in these workers, we analyzed whole blood samples from 100 male e-waste workers and 49 controls from the GEOHealth II project (2017–2018 in Accra, Ghana) using LC-MS/MS.

pmc-12436788.title: Cognitive function and cannabis use in first episodes of psychosis
pmc-12436788.creator: P Fuentes-Pérez, P Cordero Andrés, C Ovejas-Catalán, R Pérez Iglesias, P Suárez Pinilla, C Flor Gómez, D De la Sierra Biddle, M L Ramírez Bonilla, J Vázquez-Bourgon
pmc-12436788.description: IntroductionThe association between cannabis use and cognitive functioning in individuals experiencing a first episode of psychosis (FEP) is inconsistent, with some studies reporting deterioration (Bogaty et al. J Psychiatr Res 2018; 99:22-32), others indicating improved performance (Rodríguez-Sánchez et al. Schizophr Res 2010; 124:142-151), and some finding no difference.

pmc-12471891.title: The Impact of Postoperative Urinary Diversion on Surgical Outcomes of Hypospadias Repair: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Pediatric Literature
pmc-12471891.creator: Maria Escolino, Maria Sofia Caracò, Valerio Mazzone, Claudia Di Mento, Francesca Carraturo, Flavio Perricone, Giovanni Esposito, Mauro Porcaro, Ciro Esposito
pmc-12471891.description: Background and Objectives: The optimal postoperative urinary diversion strategy after hypospadias repair remains debated, with variability in type, material, and duration. Pediatric-specific data are limited. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate how urinary diversion type and duration affected surgical outcomes after pediatric hypospadias repair.

pmc-12613453.title: Changes in life expectancy across selected countries in the Western Pacific Region and their underlying risk factors, 1990–2021
pmc-12613453.creator: Yan Zheng, Stefanos Tyrovolas, Paul SF Yip, Isaac Sasson
pmc-12613453.description: BackgroundIn accordance with the global trend, over the past decades, countries in the Western Pacific Region (WPR) have also experienced substantial improvement in life expectancy. However, this accomplishment was coupled with the differences between countries.MethodsUsing the latest data from the Global Burden of Disease study, we explored the underlying reasons for changes in life expectancy among observed WPR countries.

pmc-13570106.title: Sex-Specific Adolescent Development of the Trochlea and Distal Femoral Physis: A 3D Shape Modeling Study
pmc-13570106.creator: Bryan Khoo, Marissa Lee Sinopoli, Christian E Wright, Amin Alayleh, Alan Anaya Gallegos, Seth L Sherman, Scott Delp, Akshay Chaudhari, Kevin G Shea, Anthony A Gatti
pmc-13570106.description: Background:Trochlear dysplasia is a primary risk factor for patellar instability and is associated with high recurrence rates, early arthritis, and poor return-to-sport outcomes. Surgical correction with trochleoplasty can improve tracking but carries risks in skeletally immature patients, including physeal damage and growth disturbance.
